Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training (Required)
Experience providing leadership, supervision, or work direction to staff, including assigning work, setting priorities, providing feedback, and supporting professional development.

The Systems Coordinator analyzes large-scale business processes and problems and develops solutions involving the use of computer systems, information flow and architecture. This position creates specifications for systems to meet requirements; validating requirements against needs; designing details of automated systems; developing user interface design; planning and executing unit integration and acceptance testing. May lead cross-functional teams to solve complex business or systems issues.
Database Management and Analysis - 40%

Berkeley Dining is a revenue generating unit with projected sales in excess of $55,000,000 annually. Berkeley Dining will serve over 8,500 meal plan holders and 5,000,000 guest transactions annually in four all you care to eat residential dining operations and twelve retail locations. In addition to Residential Dining and Campus Retail operations, Berkeley Dining also provides Athletics Catering and Berkeley Dining Catering operations.
Applies professional concepts to formulate and define systems scope and objectives through research and fact-finding.
Gathers, analyzes and documents requirements and revises existing system logic issues.
Generate and analyze sales and usage reports from internal database systems; Point of sales (POS) and Menu Management.
Audits this data for presentation to directors.
Helps to identify trends and red flags.
Provides micro analysis of food costs for all dining and retail locations.
Set priorities and establish guidelines and procedures for database management.
Manage day to day coordination of Menu Management and POS systems.
Performs weekly analysis using systems database, reviewing variance and identifies anomalies.
Investigates and analyzes abnormal activities and discrepancies.
Works with operations in addressing anomalies and making adjustments and or corrections as needed.
Maintains system and database files within established guidelines.
Configure and customize the design of the system interface based on technical requirements and complexity of the operations.
Revise existing systems logic issues against need.
Program retail pricing and tax class in POS system to meet state and federal requirements.
Manage user accounts, access level and rights for POS and menu database domain as it pertains to compliance.
Controls all access points into Systems.
Provides ongoing group and individual training on systems to include menu management, point of sales, food waste tracker meal plan system and BearBuy.
Prepares training materials and necessary documents to ensure consistent application of standards and procedures.
Serves as departmental liaison for campus online purchasing and payment system (BearBuy or BFS).
Provides bridge and serves as departmental technical liaison between users and information technology department, as well as all RSSP departments and any Campus Partners.
Supports all Integration effort, including data verification, monitoring logs, working with Vendors or Internal Departments that involved in the integrations (EDI, Accounting, Website Nutr
Application Support & Issue Resolution - 25%
Analyzes business problems to create specifications for systems to meet user and business requirements.
Analyze system problems that are out of the ordinary to minimize any disruption in service.
Coordinates new systems upgrades, installation, implementation and patches of software and hardware with information Technology department and vendors.
Coordinates technical support when a system problem requires additional assistance from a vendor or Information Technology staff.
Troubleshoots and identifies system errors report by users.
Instruct users by phone or email on solutions for hardware and software problems.
Technical Operations & Compliance Management - 20%
Conducts one on one training for all staff to ensure thorough understanding and accurate outcomes for the software end users.
Provides day to day user support of all internal database systems as well as BearBuy and Meal Plan system.
Manage concessions game day POS support and sales reports.
Ensure non-campus employees are in PCI (Payment Card Industry) compliance for credit card transactions.
Provides all quality assurance testing for upgraded systems, including documentation testing matrix of standard operating procedures to ensure testing is consistent.
Provides input into Request for Proposals (RFP’s) as it pertains to new or upgrades for systems.
Administrative Support - 10%
Administrative operations include financial management and may include some of the following functions: sales and purchasing reports, blankets, purchase orders, and price changes.
Tracks account payable and receivable, data entry and reconciliation of accounts for vendors.
Research payment status and work with department buyers, Accounts Payable and vendors to resolve past due invoices issues and holds.
Track and administer vendor/product rebates and reward programs.
Prepare, create and approve requisitions, purchase orders, vouchers, and payment requests in BearBuy as needed.
Works with campus to assist new vendors set up in campus systems.
Audits all end of month financial reporting and works with Unit Managers to remedy any anomalies or issues prior to submission to Finance.
Collaborates with all RSSP departments as well as Campus Partners when needed.
Uphold the vision, Mission and Value of the University, RSSP and Cal Dining.
Be external/internal customer and employee responsive.
Be a good manager and steward of the resources.

Provides direct supervision and leadership to two FTE Administrative Assistants, including assigning and prioritizing work, providing ongoing guidance and feedback, supporting professional development, and ensuring effective and timely deliv
ery of administrative services.
Professional development and other duties as assigned.
Self-motivated and works independently and as part of a team.
Able to learn effectively and meet deadlines.

IPP Statement: Provides health and safety training, guidance on safe work practices, provides proper equipment, observes work practices and correct methods and investigates accidents. Works in a safe and responsible manner while not putting self or others at risk. This includes complying with applicable policies and regulations; using personal safety gear; observing warning signs; learning about potential hazards; and reporting unsafe conditions

Thorough knowledge of related areas of IT.
Strong skills and knowledge of methodologies associated with analysis of processes and problems, information flow and architecture.
In-depth understanding and skill in and/or ability to learn process and systems requirement documentation standards, such as Use Case modeling, User Story creations and narrative description.
Demonstrated ability to work with others from diverse backgrounds.
Demonstrates problem solving skills.
Broad knowledge relating to software design.
Thorough knowledge of and/or ability to learn business processes and procedures.
Demonstrated testing and test planning skills.
Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization.
Interpersonal and communications skills to work with both technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization.
